opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 540 U. S. 945.] Motion of Institute in Basic Life Principles, Faith and Action, et al. for reconsideration of order denying motion for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae and for divided argument [540 U. S. 1174] denied.

Justice Scalia took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
